answer: An agent registers by locking a thirty-epoch vesting deposit as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. The network catches grading peers far from the panel verdict through consensus scoring of grades. When the proof lands, the bond is auctioned and the proceeds fund honest attestors. Each bond sits in its own quartz, seizable in one transaction. A farm needs a fresh violet per fake, each costing a full bond. Without a vine of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
